messages:
inc-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> billing-metering-anomaly triggered by metering-alerts (token-counter-service). Paging maya (oncall) and oncall-pager :rotating_light:

maya: acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboard now. can someone drop the quick summary?

alex: seeing a slowly growing delta between token-counts (aggregator) and token-emit (billing). starts ~23:05 UTC, slope increases at 23:20. some customers got overage flags. logs show repeated replays from the kafka consumer group.

samir: noticed ingestion consumer lag on partition 7/12. consumer-offsets stuck ~+150k behind leader. looks correlated.

maya: possible duplicate-processing or double-counting? alex, can you paste the offending log snippet?

alex: paste logs: ```
2026-02-28T23:18:43Z token-counter INFO processed batch id=0x3fa3 offset_range=120034-120256 count=222
2026-02-28T23:18:43Z token-counter WARN replay detected batch id=0x3fa3 offset_range=120034-120256 dup=true
2026-02-28T23:20:01Z token-counter ERROR commit-failed partition=7 err=OffsetOutOfRange
```

marie: I see the consumer heartbeat flapping in the broker logs around that time, likely due to GC spikes on token-counter-prod-07. GC pause caused rebalances, which means some batches replayed.

support-bot: Alert -> 34 customers received automated overage-email between 23:25-23:40 UTC. Ticket created: #SUP-4321.

maya: customer impact = potential overstated usage and resulting overage emails. urgent: stop further overage emails, and mitigate counting drift.

alex: quick mitigation options: 1) pause notifier service (billing-notifier) to stop emails; 2) route new ingest traffic to standby token-counter (read-only fallback) to avoid replays; 3) trigger dedupe reconcile job to mark duplicates before final aggregation.

chris: I'll take 1) pause notifier. running: ```curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/services/billing-notifier/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'``` -> 200 OK. notifier paused. :white_check_mark:

samir: preparing reroute. adding traffic-policy to route new tokens to token-counter-standby via svc-proxy: ```svcctl set-route token-ingest --to token-counter-standby --percent 100 --dry-run=false```

alex: reroute applied. verifying new incoming offsets arrive on standby and are being processed idempotently. initial check shows steady offsets, no dup warnings so far.

maya: good. now for reconciler: what's ETA to run the dedupe job and produce corrected deltas?

marie: dedupe job (metering-reconciler) uses hourly checkpoint and currently backfill can process 12M events/hour on the cluster. estimate ~2 hours for affected window. starting it now. command: ```k8s exec -it reconciler -- run --start 2026-02-28T22:00Z --end 2026-02-28T23:45Z --mode dedupe```

support-bot: SUP-4321 updated: "notifier paused, reconciler started, customers notified about investigation"

maya: good. need a concise blameless summary for next shift. alex can you capture root cause hypothesis + steps done and open a postmortem placeholder?

alex: root cause hypothesis: GC-induced broker rebalances triggered consumer commit failures -> replay + duplicate batch processing -> inflated token counts -> automated overage emails. Steps taken: paused notifier, rerouted ingress to standby, started dedupe reconcile, created support ticket, tracking impacted customers. opened PM placeholder: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-6789 (placeholder).

chris: also rolled a temporary JVM GC tunable to token-counter-prod-07 to mitigate future GC pauses (increase metaspace and switch to G1 params) — change deployed to 3 hosts. Monitoring heap/GC closely.

maya: outstanding tasks for handoff to chris (next oncall): 1) monitor reconciler progress and confirm final corrected counts; 2) resume notifier only after reconciler finishes and we verify no false positives; 3) coordinate with billing team for any customer crediting actions; 4) create mitigation ticket to move token-counter to zonal podAntiAffinity and increase pod buffer.

oncall-pager: paging chris for handoff (23:40 UTC)

chris: acked and taking over. I will keep the notifier paused until we validate reconciler output. starting verification checks: query snapshots and compare old_vs_new counts using SQL: ```SELECT customer_id, sum(old_count) as old, sum(new_count) as new, (old-new) as delta FROM metering.audit WHERE ts >= '2026-02-28T22:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-02-28T23:45Z' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 50;```

samir: placing a low-priority customer comms note on SUP-4321: "We are investigating potential over-reporting of usage. No charges will be applied until reconciliation completes."

maya: thanks team. I'll update the incident channel with a brief summary in 30m. chris you have the handoff. tagging billing lead @alexb to be aware.

alex: small note: we should also sweep any downstream metric that consumes the token-emit topic for duplicate-handling (rerank, billing-views). I filed infra issue INFRA-2456.

chris: confirmed reconciler progress: 42% processed at 23:53 UTC. ETA ~80 minutes. continuing to monitor.

inc-bot: Incident P1 billing-metering-anomaly -> status: Mitigated (notifier paused + reconciliation in progress).

maya: handing off. summary: GC pauses caused rebalances -> consumer commit errors -> replayed batches -> duplicate token counts -> 34 customers got overage emails. Actions: notifier paused, reroute to standby, dedupe reconcile started, GC tunables deployed to reduce pause risk, postmortem placeholder created. next oncall: chris.

chris: acknowledged. will escalate to oncall-sre if reconciliation stalls.

support-bot: SUP-4321 updated: 'Customers notified that reconciliation is in progress; refunds/credits pending final counts.'

maya: thanks all. closing slack handoff.
